buyer_faq_1_q: Is EBC free to use for home builders?
buyer_faq_1_a: Yes, absolutely! Creating sourcing enquiries for materials and submitting appointment requests to consultants/specialists is completely free for homeowners. You only pay for the materials or services you decide to purchase.
buyer_faq_2_q: Why do I need to choose three time slots for appointments?
buyer_faq_2_a: Providing three preferred slots ensures high booking success rates. Construction specialists have busy field calendars; offering multiple options allows them to immediately accept a time that perfectly fits their live schedule, eliminating back-and-forth communication.
buyer_faq_3_q: How does EBC Escrow protect my payments?
buyer_faq_3_a: When you accept a quote or confirm a booking, your payment is held securely in EBC Escrow. Funds are only released to the dealer or consultant once they deliver the materials to your site or complete the verified build milestone.
buyer_faq_4_q: Can EBC help transport heavy raw materials to my plot?
buyer_faq_4_a: Yes! EBC operates an integrated, live-tracked B2B logistics fleet. Once you approve a yard's product quotation, EBC coordinates loading, trucking, and site delivery, offering transparent shipping milestones straight to your phone.

faq_1_a: EBC helps you get fair material prices, trusted service providers, and engineer guidance for building or renovating your home — all in one place.
faq_2_q: I am building my house in a small town — will you support me?
faq_2_a: Yes. EBC is designed especially for Tier 2 & Tier 3 towns — including every digitally aware peoples of urban, semi-urban and rural zones in India.
faq_3_q: I already have a contractor/mason. Can I still use EBC?
faq_3_a: Yes! You can use EBC for material price comparison, Engineer BOQ verification, quality check visits, and tracking project budget. Your contractor continues working — EBC adds transparency & support.
faq_4_q: Is this more expensive than my local shop?
faq_4_a: Usually NO — you pay similar or better market prices, and save money by avoiding over-buying materials, reducing rework costs, and getting better material–work match.
faq_5_q: Can EBC provide service providers like mason, plumber, electrician, painter?
faq_5_a: Yes — EBC facilitates making appointments with verified workers with ratings & past job records.
faq_6_q: Will EBC give me guidance on materials — which brand is good?
faq_6_a: Yes — EBC's Conference Hall guides you on cement grade, TMT steel type, bricks & aggregates quality, and waterproofing choices for a longer-lasting home.
faq_7_q: Can I place material orders & fix appointments with professional service providers?
faq_7_a: Yes — everything is digital: orders & deliveries, quotes & documents, appointment acceptance, and engineer site visits.
faq_8_q: Do I have to pay for engineer site visits?
faq_8_a: Basic advice is free. Paid site visits / supervision are optional if you want strong quality control.
faq_9_q: What if the material/service quality is poor or I face any issue?
faq_9_a: You can return the material, replace the service provider, and mark reviews. Your home is protected by the EBC support layer to ensure fair resolution.
faq_10_a: Simple: Just consult with an expert with your plot size / renovation need. Alternatively, use EBC's conference hall and AI-powered cost calculator.
faq_bonus_q: I live outside India, home is in India — can EBC help?
faq_bonus_a: Yes — you can monitor everything remotely with updates from your hired responsive manpower (EBC's customer reviewed or verified).

solution_item_1_modal_heading: Material Depo in EBC (ECON Building Centre)
solution_item_1_modal_p1_desc: A single, trusted marketplace where all building and construction materials—branded and local—are listed with standardized categories, pricing logic, GST, and availability across PAN-India.
solution_item_1_modal_p2_desc: Eliminates ambiguity and middle-layer inefficiencies by connecting verified manufacturers, dealers, and local suppliers directly to end users with transparent specifications and supply options.
solution_item_1_modal_p3_desc: Ensures the right material is available at the right location, at the right time, and is seamlessly linked with related services (transport, installation, workers), reducing cost overruns and construction delays.
solution_item_2_p3: Quality, Risk & Cost Control Layer of EBC
solution_item_2_modal_heading: Technical Cabin refers to a dedicated expert-support room/function (physical or digital) within the ECON Building Centre ecosystem.
solution_item_2_modal_p1_desc: A space where qualified engineers, architects, and technical experts verify drawings, material selections, BOQs, estimates, and construction methods to ensure technical correctness.
solution_item_2_modal_p2_desc: Acts as a help desk for homeowners, contractors, and dealers to resolve doubts related to materials, specifications, quantities, and cost optimization.
solution_item_2_modal_p3_title: Quality, Risk & Cost Control Layer of EBC:
solution_item_2_modal_p3_desc: Functions as the technical backbone of EBC, preventing material mismatch, overconsumption, structural errors, and substandard execution.
solution_item_3_modal_heading: Manpower Hub in the EBC platform can be expressed as follows:
solution_item_3_modal_p1_desc: A dedicated EBC module where skilled, semi-skilled, and unskilled construction manpower are onboarded, verified, and made discoverable PAN-India.
solution_item_3_modal_p2_desc: Enables homeowners and builders to search, compare, book, and schedule manpower based on skill, location, and availability.
solution_item_3_modal_p3_desc: Provides control for worker verification, attendance tracking, standardized wage benchmarks, and digital payments.
solution_item_4_modal_heading: Fabricator Area in EBC refers to a dedicated functional zone for metal and structural fabrication activities.
solution_item_4_modal_p1_desc: Lists fabricators, fabrication jobs (gates, grills, etc.) and required raw materials in one controlled area.
solution_item_4_modal_p2_desc: Enables customers to post requirements, receive quotations, assign jobs to verified fabricators, and track progress.
solution_item_4_modal_p3_desc: Allows EBC to standardize rates, verify credentials, and maintain workmanship quality across projects.
solution_item_5_modal_heading: Hiring Terminal room in EBC can be expressed as:
solution_item_5_modal_p1_desc: A dedicated digital space where customers can search and book verified workers and service providers.
solution_item_5_modal_p2_desc: Allocation hub that manages real-time worker availability, job assignment, scheduling, and completion tracking.
solution_item_5_modal_p3_desc: Ensures background-verified manpower, standardized rates, and dispute-resolution support.
solution_item_6_modal_heading: Contract Desk room in EBC can be expressed as follows:
solution_item_6_modal_p1_desc: A digital space where users can negotiate scope, pricing, and terms, and formally finalize construction contracts.
solution_item_6_modal_p2_desc: Enables structured documentation, approvals, milestones, and payment schedules for clarity and accountability.
solution_item_6_modal_p3_desc: Linking verified vendors and monitored execution so projects move from quotation to completion with confidence.
solution_item_7_modal_p1_desc: A virtual space where stakeholders can meet for structured discussions on projects, estimates, and designs.
solution_item_7_modal_p2_desc: Used for decision-making, such as finalizing BOQs, comparing brands, and resolving site issues.
solution_item_7_modal_p3_desc: Where outcomes, shared documents, and approvals are documented for transparency and smooth execution.
solution_item_8_modal_heading: AI Cost Calculator in EBC platform can be clearly expressed as:
solution_item_8_modal_p1_desc: Uses AI to calculate accurate construction cost by mapping project inputs with real-time platform prices.
solution_item_8_modal_p2_desc: Compares scenarios and shows cost savings, helping users control budget before money is spent.
solution_item_8_modal_p3_desc: Converts final cost estimate into a shopping + service plan, allowing users to directly purchase materials.
solution_item_9_modal_heading: Service Support in EBC (ECON Building Centre)
solution_item_9_modal_p1_desc: Access a curated list of verified construction service providers with ratings and reviews.
solution_item_9_modal_p2_desc: Eliminate negotiating hassle by using standardized rate benchmarks for various services.
solution_item_9_modal_p3_desc: Benefit from EBC's oversight system designed to ensure services are delivered to your satisfaction.
